DLC2314:3:t_3:22.en:
$$エイミー$$
「You will, $$チェインバー#pilot$$?」

DLC2314:3:t_3:23.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「After analyzing Ensign $$レド$$'s behavior over the past few days and comparing it with various data supplied by $$ＡＧ$$...」

DLC2314:3:t_3:24.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「It is predicted that Ensign $$レド$$ will now whisper what are known as words of love.」

DLC2314:3:t_3:27.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Furthermore, according to the data this unit has obtained, those words achieve maximum tactical effectiveness under conditions involving the sea and a sunset.」

DLC2314:3:t_3:28.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Therefore, this unit has predicted Ensign $$レド$$'s next action and will perform it on his behalf.」

DLC2314:3:t_3:30.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「...Ensign $$レド$$'s agitation measured. This unit's operational objective confirmed successful.」

DLC2314:3:t_3:32.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit has performed the act known as a joke, as instructed by $$ＡＧ$$, and simultaneously confirmed its usefulness.」

DLC2314:3:t_3:33.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「With this operation successful, this unit is now also capable of assisting Ensign $$レド$$ in similar situations.」

DLC2314:3:t_3:34.en:
$$レド$$
「Wh-wh-what the hell are you, anyway?!」

DLC2314:3:t_3:35.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$レド$$! If you shout like that, your throat will...!」

DLC2314:3:t_3:37.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit will answer Ensign $$レド$$'s question.」

DLC2314:3:t_3:38.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit is $$チェインバー・Ｋ６８２１#robot$$. I am Ensign $$レド$$'s Life Support Enlightenment Interface System.」

DLC2314:3:t_3:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...I'm honored that my assistance has been useful to $$レド$$ and $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

DLC2314:3:t_3:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now we can have $$チェインバー#pilot$$ move on to the next step, too.」

DLC2314:3:t_3:44.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just how far can AI... can machines and humans cross the boundary between them, I wonder...?」

DLC2314:3:t_3:45.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And with that, everyone... Until we meet again.」

DLC2314:4:t_000:0.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「There they are! There's quite a lot of them!」

DLC2314:4:t_000:1.en:
$$リジット$$
「For now, we have no choice but to put our faith in them.」

DLC2314:4:t_001:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「As predicted, enemy machines are determined to be AI-controlled unmanned units.」

DLC2314:4:t_001:2.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Yeah! I'm ready any time!」

DLC2314:4:t_001:3.en:
$$エイミー$$
「W-wait a second! Let me take a deep breath first!」

DLC2314:4:t_001:5.en:
$$エイミー$$
「It's all right, $$レド$$. I'm just a little nervous.」

DLC2314:4:t_001:6.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Besides, I can't leave $$チェインバー#pilot$$ in $$ピニオン$$'s hands.」

DLC2314:4:t_001:7.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You've got some nerve, $$エイミー$$. Me and Tin Man here will blow those guys away in no time.」

DLC2314:4:t_001:8.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Honestly! $$チェインバー#pilot$$ is $$レド$$'s partner! We're only borrowing him!」

DLC2314:4:t_001:9.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit confirms that Ensign $$レド$$ has temporarily delegated command authority to you. Awaiting instructions.」

DLC2314:4:t_002:1.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Stop! Stop, $$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

DLC2314:4:t_002:3.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「What are you doing, $$エイミー$$?! A man does one thing: charge!」

DLC2314:4:t_002:4.en:
$$エイミー$$
「No! Charge in blindly, and you'll get mobbed!」

DLC2314:4:t_002:6.en:
$$リジット$$
「Will they... be all right...?」

DLC2314:4:t_002:7.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「At this point, all we can do is leave it to luck.」

DLC2314:4:t_002:8.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Good grief. I suppose I'll have to do all the hard work.」

DLC2314:4:t_002:9.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Here we come, $$サイデリアル$$! Me, Tin Man, and...」

DLC2314:4:t_002:10.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Me and $$レド$$ will protect the $$ガルガンティア船団$$, no matter what!」

DLC2314:4:t_002:11.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Correction requested. This unit's designation is not Tin Man.」

DLC2314:4:t_003:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「Why is $$ピニオン$$ in $$チェインバー#pilot$$?!」

DLC2314:4:t_003:3.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「$$レド$$ lost his voice. I'm filling in for him.」

DLC2314:4:t_003:6.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I see. No wonder $$チェインバー#pilot$$'s movements were erratic... In other words, a complete mess.」

DLC2314:4:t_003:7.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「What was that, you bastard?! You got a problem with the way I fight?!」

DLC2314:4:t_003:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「Are you all right with this, $$レド$$?!」

DLC2314:4:t_003:10.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$ is unable to answer.」

DLC2314:4:t_003:11.en:
$$アルト$$
「What about you, $$チェインバー#pilot$$?」

DLC2314:4:t_003:12.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「A $$パイロット支援啓発インターフェイス$$... and, by extension, a $$マシンキャリバー$$ exists because there is a pilot.」

DLC2314:4:t_003:13.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Therefore, this unit will follow the instructions of $$ピニオン$$ and $$エイミー$$, to whom Ensign $$レド$$ delegated command authority.」

DLC2314:4:t_003:14.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「So basically, you trust us!」

DLC2314:4:t_003:15.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Thank you, $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

DLC2314:4:t_003:16.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「A-anyway! First, we'll protect the $$ガルガンティア船団$$!」

DLC2314:4:t_003:18.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Heh...! Now this is getting interesting!」

DLC2314:4:t_003:19.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「You're all fired up, but the enemy's unmanned machines, so making them hear our songs won't...」

DLC2314:4:t_003:20.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Machines, humans, it makes no difference! I'm singing my song!!」

DLC2314:4:t_004:0.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「That's the way, $$バサラ$$! Now we're getting fired up!」

DLC2314:4:t_004:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「...Is this all right, $$アルト$$?」

DLC2314:4:t_005:1.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「How is that young man's mental state, I wonder?」

DLC2314:4:t_005:3.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Don't look so gloomy, $$レド$$! We won a huge victory!」

DLC2314:4:t_005:4.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Let's go home, $$レド$$. I'll make you some tea that's good for your throat.」

review.context: Chamber teases Ledo with romance data from AG; the flashback shows Amy and Pinion issuing conflicting commands until the Macross pilots arrive.
decisions: Chamber's final system designation deliberately changes Pilot Support into Life Support, reflecting his expanded role.
The sea/sunset confession is Chamber's successful joke, not an actual confession by Ledo.
